channel.title: Chaitanya Meesala
channel.description: Writing and notes on autonomous systems, agent infrastructure, rollout intelligence, and reliable software.

item.title: Trustworthy Autonomy
item.description: Trust is not a personality trait of the model. It is a property of the system surrounding it.

item.title: What does “good” mean for an agent?
item.description: AI exposes how much of quality was previously implicit infrastructure.

item.title: The Agent Harness Is the Product
item.description: The model supplies general intelligence. The harness turns that intelligence into dependable work in a particular world.

item.title: Skills aren’t policies
item.description: Procedure, authority, and enforcement are different concerns.

item.title: Memory should accumulate judgment
item.description: Transcripts preserve history. Useful memory changes the next decision.

item.title: Rollouts Are Decision Problems
item.description: A rollout reviewer should not merely detect anomalies. It should decide what the available evidence justifies doing next.

item.title: Context engineering vs. harness engineering
item.description: Context makes the world legible; the harness makes action dependable.

item.title: Why agent verifiers fail
item.description: A second model does not automatically create independent assurance.
